title: Failure drills: a worker lost, and the hub down
purpose: Cut the hub off from one worker, and check that new jobs still run. Take the hub's queue controller down, and check that a running job is not affected.

steps.display: kubectl --context hub -n kueue-system patch secret cpu-a-kubeconfig   # simulate losing cpu-a: its credentials stop working

steps.output:
NAME    CONNECTED   AGE
cpu-a   False       22m
cpu-b   True        22m
gpu     True        22m

steps.display: kubectl --context hub create -f job.yaml   # llm/during-outage: queue cpu, 1 pod(s) x cpu 1
kubectl --context hub -n kueue-system patch secret cpu-a-kubeconfig   # restore the credentials
kubectl --context hub create -f job.yaml   # llm/long-run: queue cpu, 1 pod(s) x cpu 1
kubectl --context hub create -f job.yaml   # a new submission while the hub's Kueue is down
steps.output: Error from server (InternalError): error when creating "STDIN": Internal error occurred: failed calling webhook "mjob.kb.io": failed to call webhook: Post "https://kueue-webhook-service.kueue-system.svc:443/mutate-batch-v1-job?timeout=10s": no endpoints available for service "kueue-webhook-service"

steps.display: kubectl --context cpu-a -n llm get pods   # the running job, hub still down
steps.output:
NAME             READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
long-run-bpvnl   1/1     Running   0          30s

steps.display: kubectl --context hub -n kueue-system rollout status deploy/kueue-controller-manager --timeout=180s
steps.output:
Waiting for deployment "kueue-controller-manager" rollout to finish: 0 of 1 updated replicas are available...
deployment "kueue-controller-manager" successfully rolled out

checks.because: MultiKueue checks every worker connection and reports it on the MultiKueueCluster.

checks.description: a new job still runs, in the other CPU worker
checks.because: The hub offers work only to workers that are active. It chose cpu-b.

checks.description: cpu-a rejoins when its credentials return
checks.because: No manual step is needed: the connection is retried.

checks.description: the job already running in the worker is not affected by the hub being down
checks.because: Once dispatched, a job runs entirely inside its worker. The hub is not in the data path.

checks.description: a new submission is refused while the hub's queue controller is down
checks.because: Kueue's admission webhook is part of the controller. Only new batch submissions are affected; nothing already running is.
